SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM schools AS T1
INNER JOIN satscores AS T2 ON T1.CDSCode = T2.cds
WHERE T2.AvgScrMath > 400 AND T1.Virtual = 'F';

SELECT MAX(frpm.`Percent (%) Eligible Free (Ages 5-17)`) AS max_eligible_free_rate
FROM frpm
INNER JOIN satscores ON frpm.CDSCode = satscores.cds
WHERE (satscores.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / satscores.NumTstTakr) > 0.3;
